scope: Own Android export/account code plus read-only sampled billing/auth/CI baseline. No production pentest or device security certification.

findings.scenario: Plaintext intermediate exports in external cache could be read by another storage-authorized app on older supported Android, before the user-facing save/share.
findings.fix: Only internal cache for intermediate ZIP/PDF and two narrowly scoped FileProvider cache paths. Existing user-owned Downloads copies are preserved.

findings.scenario: Owner-ID-only checks allowed old work and completed UI actions after logout and a new login as the same owner. Account dialog scan replies also lacked an identity boundary before cache mutation.
findings.fix: Owner plus login epoch; completed Save/Share identity checks before and after asynchronous work; immutable screen identity and scan generation; destroy cancels scans/work. Completed exports stay readable after paid entitlement expiry.

findings.scenario: An exported provider invokes startRingtoneAndVibration on read while VoIPService exists without validating the requested URI/caller. A local app could trigger an unintended call sound side effect. No demonstrated data theft or universal DND bypass.
findings.nextStep: Review exact URI and eligible incoming-call state while preserving Android system ringtone-provider access; add caller/state fixtures before altering the platform contract.

verification.exportHost: 69 checks PASS: actual session/account exporter, private ZIP output, controlled queued callbacks, expiry/logout/new-owner/same-owner relogin
verification.legacySession: PASS concurrent one-shot, enqueue/terminal guard, unique session paths and source wiring
verification.negativeControls: 4 compiled security mutants and 4 UI source-contract mutants rejected
verification.androidApi: 6 real Java sources compile against cached app classes plus Android 36; only a deprecation note
verification.billingCiBaseline: 104 Node checks PASS; one actual-shell CI check was not run successfully because bash was absent from this PowerShell process PATH (spawnSync bash ENOENT), not recorded as a product failure

limitations: No emulator, hardware, MediaStore lifecycle, or end-to-end APK verification.
A user-authorized Downloads copy already in progress is not cancelled or deleted after logout; stale callbacks cannot initiate another save/share.
UI security guards have source-contract checks and real Android API compilation, not synthesized Android UI interaction.
The baseline audit is sampled and incomplete; no claim of absence of all vulnerabilities.
